description: Build a church or ministry page in one step from facts the user gives. In this order: a Give link (in the spotlight, unless another block already has it), a Save contact card with the address, service times, phone and email, Plan a visit, Watch live, the newest sermon, Events, Groups, Prayer requests, the church's app and an FAQ. Ask the user for these; leave out what they don't have. Never make up times, links or answers. The blocks go on top of anything already on the page. One that can't be added (a site that doesn't answer, a blocked link) is skipped with the reason and the rest still go on; the result lists both. Each call adds blocks, so don't call it again for blocks it already added.

address.description: The church's address, on one line.

appUrl.description: The church's app on the App Store or Google Play.

dialCode.description: Country code for the phone number, like "+44". Defaults to "+1".

eventsUrl.description: The events or registrations page. Becomes "Events".

faqs.description: Questions visitors ask, like "What should I wear?", "Is there something for kids?" or "Where do I park?", with the church's own answers. Pairs without an answer are left out.

giveUrl.description: The church's online giving page. Becomes a "Give" link in the spotlight.

groupsUrl.description: The page for joining a small group. Becomes "Groups".

liveUrl.description: Where services stream live. Becomes "Watch live".

phone.description: The church's phone number. Without a + it is taken as a US number unless dialCode is given.

planVisitUrl.description: A page for first-time visitors. Becomes "Plan a visit".

prayerUrl.description: A prayer request form. Becomes "Prayer requests".

sermonsUrl.description: A YouTube channel (youtube.com/@name) or playlist, or a sermon podcast or RSS feed. Shows the newest sermon and updates every hour.

times.description: The church's weekly service times, shown on the contact card with the address. Only times the user gives; ask for the time zone if unsure.

entries.description: One entry per time, up to 20: a day with two services has two entries. [] removes the times.

day.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday.

end.description: Optional 24-hour "HH:MM" end. An end before the start runs past midnight.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the times are in, named for a place, like "America/Chicago" or "Europe/London" (or "UTC"). Not an abbreviation like "EST" or an offset. Ask the user if unsure.

title.description: Shown above the times, like "Service times", "Mass times" or "Hours". Defaults to "Service times".

website.description: The church's website, for the contact card. Left out, the card links this page; "" for no website.

name: start_church_page
title: Start a church page
